notes: §1985:X.5.2.4 GR1: 'Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the name of the called program', which for a COBOL program 'must contain the program-name contained in the PROGRAM-ID paragraph'; non-COBOL naming is implementor-defined. CallBinder.BindCall/ProgramName take literal-1 or the identifier (evaluated at each execution), ExternalizedNames.FormInEdition trims the padding spaces and spells the name in the edition's fold, and ProgramTable.CallProgram/ResolveVisible match it against the PROGRAM-ID names by ExternalizedNames.Same (the DOC-A.1-68 mapping). Probes: (d) PIC X(8) identifier with trailing spaces, the same identifier reassigned between CALLs, a group identifier, PL(1:4) reference-modified, lower-case "subb" (reaches SUBB by the documented fold), PL holding SUBAXXXX and all SPACES (ON EXCEPTION taken); (b/c) numeric identifier (COBOL1681), numeric literal (COBOL1627), PROGRAM-POINTER (COBOL0900), FUNCTION target, AS NESTED (COBOL0900), empty CALL and ON OVERFLOW twice (COBOL2269) refused at 85. The witness calls a separately compiled program by literal and by identifier.

next.reason: 1985: 'Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the name of the called program', which for a COBOL program 'must contain the program-name contained in the PROGRAM-ID paragraph'; non-COBOL naming is implementor-defined. §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3b keeps 'the value of literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the program-name of the program being called' (mapped to the externalized name per §2023:8.3.2.2) and implementor-defined non-COBOL naming (documented per §2023:A.1 13); §2023:14.9.4.4 GR1 makes the caller the activating runtime element. Added case: 'If identifier-1 references a program-pointer data item, the data item referenced by identifier-1 contains the location of the program being called' (§2023:14.9.4.3 SR1 now allows it; 1985 SR2 refused it), and a prototype-name may name the program.
